build_LunarMultiheadAttention: build a LunarMultiheadAttention module with embed_dim, num_heads, and num_pheads for Linformer-style linear complexity attention
build_LunarCausalAttention: build a LunarCausalAttention module with embed_dim and num_heads for efficient causal self-attention with linear complexity
run_efficient_causal_attention_parallel: run efficient_causal_attention_parallel to compute causal attention using batched matmul and cumsum for parallel processing
run_efficient_causal_attention_seq: run efficient_causal_attention_seq to compute causal attention step by step in a sequential loop
run_incremental_causal_attention: run incremental_causal_attention to compute one step of causal attention using an accumulated matrix and step count
